message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise violations are handled by the city’s **Code Enforcement** and **Police Department** rather than the city council itself, but the council can refer you to the proper department if you need help. ### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Method | What to Do | Contact | |--------|------------|---------| | **Online** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website.
• Go to the “Noise Complaint” page or use the “311” portal.
• Fill out the online form with details (location, time, type of noise, etc.). | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | | **Phone** | • Call 311 (the city’s non-emergency hotline).
• Tell the operator you want to file a noise complaint; they’ll route it to the Police Department or Code Enforcement. | 404‑656‑3111 | | **In‑person** | • Stop by the nearest Atlanta Police Department precinct or the City Hall’s Code Enforcement office.
• Submit a written complaint or speak with an officer. | Atlanta Police Department – 404‑656‑3111 (for general inquiries) | | **Mail** | • Send a written complaint to the City of Atlanta, Code Enforcement Division, 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309. | | ### What the Complaint Should Include 1. **Your name and contact information** (so the city can follow up). 2. **Exact location** (address or intersection). 3. **Date and time** of the noise. 4. **Description of the noise** (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). 5. **Any evidence** (photos, audio recordings, witness statements). ### City Noise Ordinance Atlanta’s noise ordinance is codified in the **City Code, Title 10, Chapter 10 – Noise**. It sets limits on decibel levels and specifies prohibited times (e.g., 10 p.m.–6 a.m.). You can review the ordinance here: https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/department-of-public-safety-division-of-traffic-and-transportation/noise-ordinance ### After Filing - The city will investigate and may issue a warning, citation, or order to stop the noise. - If the issue persists, the city can take further enforcement action. - If you’re not satisfied with the outcome, you can contact your local city council member for assistance. ### Quick Links - **Atlanta 311 Portal**: https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 - **Noise Complaint Form**: https://www.atlantaga.gov/311/noise-complaint - **City Code – Noise Ordinance**: https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/department-of-public-safety-division-of-traffic-and-transportation/noise-ordinance Feel free to let me know if you need help filling out the form or locating your nearest police precinct!
